system.effect: Rapidly lays down a Level 3 protective area ward around a room or floor space.
system.description: A roll of silver/yellow duct tape inscribed with occult sigils. Civilians who study it must pass a Spirit (Resolve) Test or become Frightened; it must be hidden or removed where the public could see it. Requisition DN 4:2 (Class 3) or 5:2 (Class 4).
